correctness_validations.doi_format: Plausible 10.18130/V3/HIGT4C syntax, consistent with the supplied University of Virginia Dataverse citation and links; resolution was not checked.
correctness_validations.grant_number_format: The three NIH identifiers have plausible activity, institute, serial, and award-year or supplement components; award existence was not externally checked.
correctness_validations.rrid_format: RRID:CVCL_0419 and RRID:CVCL_B5P3 do not match the rubric's listed SCR_/AB_ patterns. They use a semantically appropriate cell-line namespace and are not treated as failures of the dataset DOI; registry resolution was not checked.
correctness_validations.url_validity: Supplied URLs have plausible structures and domains. Live reachability was not checked. Several external repository entries explicitly lack target URLs.

issues_detected.description: Four of fourteen rubric fields are absent at their specified root locations: resources, parent_datasets, variables, and confidentiality classification.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document variables and applicable hierarchy and confidentiality information at their actual schema locations, without promoting nested file resources into root fields.

issues_detected.description: The record enumerates ten archives but identifies only ZIP as a file format. Biological modality variety does not establish payload-format variety.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document the actual formats and media types inside each archive and the formats supplied by linked repositories.

issues_detected.description: Ethical-review contacts and a deidentification rationale are present, but review determinations, consent scope, operational privacy safeguards, and data-protection assessment are incomplete.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document the applicable review or exemption determination, donor-consent and reuse scope, and privacy or reidentification assessment, including reasons where particular protections do not apply.

issues_detected.description: Detailed license and copyright restrictions are not accompanied by an explicit confidentiality classification and a clear account of applicable regulatory obligations.
issues_detected.recommendation: State the release's confidentiality classification and applicable governance or regulatory requirements, distinguishing them from licensing and FDA status.

issues_detected.description: Historical RO-Crate and FAIRSCAPE descriptions do not establish current payload-schema conformance, identifier mappings, or executable cross-modal integration procedures.
issues_detected.recommendation: Identify schemas and versions used by the June 2026 payloads and document shared identifiers, ontology mappings, and integration procedures.

issues_detected.description: FAIRSCAPE packaging is described, but software versions and comprehensive modality-specific analytical processing and quality-control procedures are missing.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document release-specific processing steps, software versions and parameters, workflow inputs and outputs, and relevant cleaning, annotation, or missing-data handling.

issues_detected.description: Collection mechanisms are substantive, but acquisition timeframes and complete collector and raw-source assignments across modalities are absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add collection periods and identify the responsible collector, source accession, and acquisition protocol for each modality and experimental condition.

issues_detected.description: Cell-line donor origins and experimental subgroups are described, but systematic selection rationale and inclusion/exclusion criteria are not sufficiently documented.
issues_detected.recommendation: Explain why these lines and conditions were selected, state relevant inclusion and exclusion criteria, and describe the resulting population coverage limits.

issues_detected.description: The platform route is documented, but current authentication or agreement requirements and access to embargoed underlying data are not resolved by the public-file statement.
issues_detected.recommendation: State the current access tier and authorization steps for each data stream, clarify whether public archives contain data or references, and document the route and conditions for embargoed content.

issues_detected.description: License and use restrictions are meaningful, but comprehensive social-impact analysis and mitigation strategies are absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Assess foreseeable misuse, unsupported clinical extrapolation, and affected populations, and document practical mitigation and discouraged-use guidance.

issues_detected.description: Version history, hashes, laboratory sources, and generic packaging do not provide complete release-specific entity-activity-agent relationships and derivation paths.
issues_detected.recommendation: Connect each released artifact to identified raw inputs, processing activities and software versions, and responsible agents using explicit narrative lineage or a provenance graph.

issues_detected.description: Representation limits are identified without standard bias categorization or a fairness analysis linked to intended AI uses.
issues_detected.recommendation: Categorize representation and measurement-coverage biases with a stated taxonomy and assess downstream consequences and mitigation or validation plans.

issues_detected.description: The project page and Dataverse reportedly disagree on the June release year. The record explicitly selects the Dataverse date and preserves the conflict, so this is not treated as an unqualified dating error.
issues_detected.recommendation: Retain the conflict annotation and update it if an authoritative correction becomes available.

issues_detected.description: The record explicitly documents conflicting source affiliations for Sali A and chooses the release-page affiliation. The supplied evidence does not independently resolve the conflict.
issues_detected.recommendation: Preserve the attributed source distinction and reconcile it against an authoritative creator or release correction when available.

semantic_insights: Project goals and current release contents are clearly distinguished: machine-readable cell maps are an objective, while computed maps are expressly absent from this release.
The root DOI, citation, latest-version identifier, and Dataverse publisher consistently identify the June 2026 release.
Funding awards and affiliated creators support the documented functional-genomics and interpretable-AI objectives.
Numeric archive sizes satisfy size availability without misrepresenting project-wide counts and volume as release-specific totals.
Version history, quarterly updates, named responsibility, and institutionally funded preservation provide strong sustainability documentation.
The cell-culture and no-human-subject-research declarations are semantically compatible, but they do not alter applicability without an independent caller declaration.
Explicit source caveats preserve uncertainty about historical processing, access status, dates, and affiliations instead of silently treating those claims as verified.
